title: The Shepherd Who Knows My Name
themeTags: you are not just a face in the crowd
reflectionQuestion: The good shepherd knows every one of his sheep by name -- and Jesus said that's how well he knows and loves you. How does it feel to know that God knows your name?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Good Shepherd, John 10:1-18). Mood=calm_peaceful. FEELING-FIRST: known by name. DISTINCT from Psalm 23 / Lost Sheep -- the center is 'he knows MY name' (Adam approved keeping it). Full expands per Adam: sheepfold gate, stranger's voice, leading to pasture, standing between wolf and flock, counting home. SHORT+FULL, NO long (Adam: 'the full is exactly where it should stop'). Indelible image: hearing your own name. Voice TBC (proposed VOICE_DAVID_SHEPHERD).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
